{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''base''' was established by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garia]] during the latter stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The base threatened [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] supply routes along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], so the Republic dispatched forces under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jonoin]] to destroy the facility. The Republic carried out an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the base, but it was unsuccessful because the base was protected by a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. Jonoin therefore ordered Republic ground forces to land on Garia and knock out the base's control center, to shut down the shield.
